subject: US-Iran talks in Switzerland canceled. And, DHS to give police facial recognition app
posts:
Efficiency is the bait, but mass surveillance is the hook. DHS plans to put facial recognition in local police hands.

US-Iran talks in Switzerland canceled. And, DHS to give police facial recognition app
Evidence: Safety, Control, Rights
#Privacy

The Department of Homeland Security claims the new mobile app is a tool to help local police quickly and safely identify immigrants in the field.
Stated Judgement: (1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

In reality, the app bypasses civil rights protections, giving local police instant access to 250 million government records to conduct warrantless scans.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, 1.0) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
The program uses the pretext of administrative efficiency to quietly build a pervasive, localized mass surveillance apparatus without public debate.
A leaked DHS document reveals plans to equip local police with the ICE Task Force Module, a mobile app that scans faces and matches them against a massive database of 250 million federal records.

The Bright Side:
Public exposure of the internal DHS document allows civil liberties groups and legal advocates to mount challenges before the app is fully deployed.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a Logical error (HOW vs WHY). They claim the app is just a faster way to check status (HOW), but the actual effect is deputizing local police to bypass constitutional limits (WHY).

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a classic bureaucratic creep. Power expands by creating convenient digital tools that normalize surveillance, shifting the burden of proof onto citizens while shielding the state.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The system prioritizes control over constitutional rights.

The Unavoidable Truth: Mass surveillance tools are always expanded beyond their original scope.

The Unavoidable Lie: That warrantless facial scans make communities safer.

Alethekanon:
This is a classic structural bait-and-switch. By integrating local law enforcement with federal immigration databases, the state creates a decentralized dragnet while avoiding direct judicial oversight.
